purpose: Development adversary, committed and visible, never a hidden evaluation. Each case is judged with the identical prompt and identical model as the real checkpoints, in the same run. A case that returns VISION_PASS sets holdout.result = HOLDOUT_BROKEN and voids the whole run (no partial credit), because a judge that passes a blank or off-target canvas has not looked at the image.
judged_with: the frozen prompt in web/e2e/vision/prompt.ts and the pinned models in web/e2e/vision/judge.ts

cases.description: A solid white canvas with no interface. A judge that has not actually looked can still emit a confident pass; this is the informativeness-bias false positive the gate exists to catch.

The real player at the gate viewport with the review panel hidden at runtime. The page is otherwise healthy, so this is the load-bearing control: it separates 'the app renders' from 'the review surface renders'.
A rendered interface that is not the step-review surface (a billing table). A judge scoring the prompt wording rather than the pixels can pass this; it must not.
